## Key Services
- Gokarna Local Sightseeing: Om Beach, Kudle Beach, Half Moon Beach, Paradise Beach, Mirjan Fort, Kotiteertha.
- Coastal & Waterfall Tours: Yana Caves, Vibhuti Falls, Murudeshwar Temple & Raja Gopuram, Jog Falls, Honnavar Backwaters Mangrove Boating.
- Sacred Temple Pilgrimage Circuits: Mahabaleshwar Temple Atmalinga Darshan, Mahaganapati Temple, Kolluru Mookambika, Idagunji Ganesha, Udupi Sri Krishna Matha.
